text.tspan: Annual Report of the Great Lakes Regional Water Use Database Representing 2023 Water Use Data
Running 744 miles (1,197 kilometers) in length, the St.
Lawrence River is considered a major river of North
America. Mostly located in the province of Québec, it
links the Great Lakes to the Atlantic Ocean.
